update_installed: {version} is installed. Restart to use it.
update_systemPackage: Update with your package manager (apt or dnf), or download it from the release page.
update_manual: This app is in a folder you cannot write to. Download the update from the release page.
update_editor: VS Code updates this extension, enbu included.
update_development: This is a development build; it is not updated.
settings_themeDescription: Color theme: system follows the OS (or VS Code), light or dark.
settings_fontSizeDescription: Body text size in px; other text scales with it.
settings_clipboardClearDescription: Seconds after which a copied secret value is cleared from the clipboard. 0 keeps it.
welcome_tagline: Share your team's .env with end-to-end encryption.
welcome_stepSignInBody: Needed for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR), which enbu suggests for a GitHub repository, and to create a new workspace. Opening a workspace already stored on another OCI registry or S3 needs no sign-in.
welcome_stepOpenBody: Choose the project folder the team shares. enbu keeps its settings there, in enbu.toml.
welcome_stepWorkspaceBody: Without enbu.toml, you create the workspace and become its first admin; then commit enbu.toml so teammates get it. With enbu.toml, this device asks to join.
welcome_stepApproveBody: Joining shows this device's fingerprint. Tell it to an admin over another channel, such as chat or in person; once they approve it on the Members screen, you can read the secrets.
init_foundDescription: This folder has no enbu.toml yet. Found a workspace for it: its secrets are kept in the storage below, and you become its first admin.
init_joinDescription: This folder's enbu.toml names a workspace. Set up this device to join it; an admin then approves it.
init_storageHint: oci://REGISTRY/REPOSITORY or s3://BUCKET/PREFIX. With a GitHub remote, enbu suggests a GHCR repository beside it.
init_plainHttp: Use HTTP for a local OCI registry
init_noGhcrName: The origin remote's repository name is not one GHCR accepts. Enter a storage.
init_noSuggestion: Enter a storage above. A folder on GitHub gets a GHCR repository beside it suggested.
init_acceptNewGenesisHint: Only after an admin confirmed out of band that they re-created the workspace.
init_ghcrHint: GHCR created the package {pkg} private to you. So that teammates can join, open it on GitHub ({owner} → Packages → {pkg} → Package settings), connect this repository and turn on 'Inherit access from repository'. Then commit enbu.toml.
init_commitHint: Share enbu.toml with the team, for example by committing it, so that teammates can join.
init_pendingHint: Ask an admin to approve this device after comparing its fingerprint: {fingerprint}
init_replacedGenesis: Trust root replaced: was {was}, now trusting the one in enbu.toml.
dashboard_duplicateKey: Key "{key}" already exists. Edit the existing secret instead.
dashboard_pullDescription: Pull secrets from storage into the output file.
dashboard_pullKept: Kept local variables enbu does not store: {keys}
dashboard_pullRemoved: Removed variables the environment no longer has: {keys}
dashboard_pullReplaceDescription: enbu cannot read this file as dotenv, so it cannot tell your local variables apart. Overwriting replaces its whole content with the environment's secrets.
environments_deleteDescription: The environment is removed from enbu.toml for everyone once the change is committed.
environments_currentCannotBeDeleted: Switch to another environment before deleting this one.
environments_purge: Also delete its stored revisions (admin only, cannot be undone)
environments_kept: Deleted {name}. Its stored revisions remain in storage.
environments_purgeEarlierDescription: An environment deleted without its revisions leaves them in storage. An admin can delete them by the incarnation shown when it was deleted (also in enbu.toml's Git history).
history_empty: No revisions changed this environment yet.
history_restored: Restored revision {index} as a new revision.
conflicts_description: These secrets were changed differently at the same time. Nothing was lost. Choose one value for each to continue.
conflicts_undecided: Choose a value for every secret.
auth_signInDescription: enbu reaches GitHub Container Registry (GHCR), which it suggests for a GitHub repository, with your GitHub sign-in.
members_pendingHint: Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the new device before approving.
members_approveWarning: An approved device can read every secret in this workspace.
members_fingerprintMatches: The fingerprint matches the one on the new device.
members_removeHint: Secrets are re-encrypted without this device. Rotate secrets it has already read.
members_grantAdminWarning: An admin can approve and remove devices, and so decide who can read every secret.
members_fingerprintConfirmed: I confirmed this fingerprint with its owner.
device_hardwareUnavailable: Hardware key storage ({backend}) is not available.
device_keyringAvailable: The OS keyring can hold keys.
device_keyringUnavailable: The OS keyring is not available.
device_hardwareDenied: Hardware key storage ({backend}) exists, but this user may not use it. New keys will not fall back to the OS keyring; run enbu doctor for how to get access.
device_keyringLocked: The OS keyring is locked. Unlock it to use keys stored there.
import_description: Add every variable of a .env file
import_overwriteTitle: Replace secrets with the file's values?
import_overwriteDescription: These secrets already hold another value: {keys}
config_invalidToml: Fix the TOML errors before switching to the GUI editor.
transfer_steps_encrypt: Encrypting for every member with age...
transfer_steps_push: Publishing the signed revision to storage...
error_not_authenticated: Sign in with GitHub to continue.
error_authentication_expired: The authentication session expired. Try again.
error_not_initialized: Set up enbu for this repository first.
error_config_protected: "{key}" in enbu.toml cannot be changed here: it decides which members the workspace trusts or where secrets are stored.
error_artifact_not_found: The requested secrets were not found.
error_not_member: This device has not been approved yet. Ask an admin to approve it.
error_untrusted_state: Stored data failed signature verification and was not used.
error_rollback_detected: Storage shows less than this device already accepted. It may be a delayed listing; try again.
error_incompatible_storage: This storage was created without a workspace control. Use an empty location.
error_secret_conflict: Concurrent edits changed the same secret differently. Nothing was lost; choose a value to continue.
error_control_forked: Two admins changed the members at the same time. Nothing else can proceed until an admin of both changes opens enbu, which joins them.
error_reencrypt_incomplete: Membership changed, but some secrets are not re-encrypted yet. Run sync to finish.
error_identity_unavailable: No usable identity backend on this device. Run 'enbu doctor' for details.
error_keyring_locked: The OS keyring is locked. Unlock it (for example by logging in to the desktop) and try again.
error_output_unreadable: {file} is not a dotenv file enbu can read. Pull again and overwrite it to replace its content.
error_trust_root_changed: enbu.toml names a different trust root (control_genesis) than this device trusts for this workspace. Do not continue unless an admin confirms out of band that they re-created the workspace; then accept the new root ('enbu init --accept-new-genesis').
error_import_conflict: {count} secrets already have different values: {keys}. Use --overwrite to replace them.
error_update_unverified: The downloaded update failed signature verification and was not installed.
auth_addAccountHint: Sign in with the GitHub account you want to add. Your browser opens automatically; you can also reopen it below.
